description: Renovate for a wide repo: systems (uv projects), stack (compose images), infra (action pins). Action pins move together in infra/ and every committed .github; floating tags are recorded weekly by sync-stack.

customManagers.description: Action pins live once, in the infra/ fragments — bump digest and version comment together.
The agent's CLI pin, the default of QWEN_CLI_VERSION in the maintenance workflow.

packageRules.description: System runtime deps: one PR per package across the systems; sync-systems refreshes the locks.
Pinned stack image tags (a pin that fixes a format): one PR, reviewed for data compatibility.
Action pins in infra/ fragments and every committed .github: one monthly PR, all planes together.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
